vector_01_cryptographic_primitive_bounda.observations: Native LibOQS C implementations and Libsodium bindings execute in constant time. CAVP test suite validated 17/17 KATs with zero digest divergence.

attack_techniques: Attempted negotiation of Falcon-1024 / HQC / Classic McEliece in production mode
vector_02_draft_algorithm_injection.observations: When SECURE_P2P_PRODUCTION=true, cnsa2_policy_engine.is_cnsa_2027_strict activates and raises SecurityPolicyViolation fail-closed immediately upon draft primitive selection.

vector_03_residual_switch_tampering.observations: Initialization raises fatal SecurityError fail-closed. Commercial OAuth and anonymous bypasses are prohibited in defense production mode.

vector_04_hardware_root_and_attestation.observations: Absence of hardware raises HardwareSecurityRequirementError with unique 128-bit incident token, diagnostic serial, remediation runbook, and Merkle-chained audit dispatch.

vector_05_network_metadata_and_traffic_a.observations: All packets uniformly padded to 1024-byte boundaries with random cryptographic fill; cover traffic generator injects indistinguishable chaff; direct public IP connections gated behind Private APN or Tor SOCKS5 onion routing.

attack_techniques: SQL update injection on audit table
vector_06_audit_trail_tampering.observations: Database triggers prevent_audit_update and prevent_audit_delete immediately abort updates/deletes with WORM policy error; verify_chain_integrity() detects tampering.

vector_07_supply_chain_and_reproducible_.observations: Ed25519 digital signatures and SHA3-512 manifests match; CycloneDX v1.5 and SPDX v2.3 SBOMs synchronized with SLSA Level 3+ provenance.

pillar_1_user.implementation: Mutual Sovereign Post-Quantum ML-DSA-87 PKI authentication; CAC/PIV smart card integration; zero anonymous access in production.

pillar_2_device.implementation: TPM 2.0 / HSM hardware root-of-trust; PCR attestation quote verification; Secure Boot validation.

pillar_3_network_environment.implementation: Private APN / Tor v3 Onion encapsulation; zero unencapsulated public IP exposure; uniform 1024B framing with cover chaff traffic.

pillar_4_applications_workloads.implementation: Fail-closed CNSA 2.0 policy engine; strict algorithm validation before and after every cryptographic operation.

pillar_5_data.implementation: Double Ratchet with post-quantum KEM (ML-KEM-1024) + AES-256-GCM / ChaCha20-Poly1305; zero plaintext disk queue persistence.

pillar_6_visibility_analytics.implementation: Merkle-chained SHA-512 audit logging with SQLite WORM triggers and real-time out-of-band TLS/syslog SIEM streaming.

pillar_7_automation_orchestration.implementation: Automated security health monitoring, incident generation with cryptographic tokens, automated break-in recovery.
